_comment: Smoke test against the free HM3D example scene (00861-GLAQ4DNUx5U), linked into 3D-Mem's data/hm3d/val/. Paths are relative to the 3D-Mem repo root, so run the CLI from there. scene_dataset_config is auto-detected from hm3d_root's parent, i.e. 3D-Mem's own data/hm3d_annotated_basis.scene_dataset_config.json -- the same file the evaluator uses.
_comment_max_objects: only ~19 of this scene's objects are visible from any navigable point, so the per-episode distinct-object budget has to stay small
